tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ྈdam chos sprul sku snying thig las:bstan srung chen po zhing skyong kun dga' gzhon nu yab yum gyi:las byang gnam lcags me'i 'khor lo dgra bgegs rdul
ྈdam chos sprul sku snying thig las:bstan srung chen po zhing skyong kun dga' gzhon nu yab yum gyi:las byang gnam lcags me'i 'khor lo dgra bgegs rdul

tei:div.tei:p: "!#ྈ dam chos sprul sku snying thig las: bstan srung chen po zhing skyong kun dga' gzhon nu yab yum gyi: las byang gnam lcags me'i 'khor lo dgra bgegs rdul rlog bzhugs:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈྈྈ bdag 'dra pad+ma bdud 'dul ngas: byang phyogs gangs can ri'i ljongs 'dir: mnga' bdag chos rgyal yab sras la: theg mchog yang zab rgya cher las: 'phral dang phugs su gdams pa dpag med byin: khyad par theg bcud sprul sku snying thig gi: chos skyong kun gyi snying khrag gcig bsdus pa'i: bstan srung chen po kun dga' gzhon nu yi: gsang sgrub zab mo'i las gzhung 'di bzhin no: de'ang thog mar le'u bcu gsum gyi sgo nas rnam par bstan te: sngon 'gro bca' gzhi'i rim pa thams cad gsang sgrub ltar bya zhing: rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su: gu ru pad+ma bdud 'dul ni: 'phags pa seng ge sgra sgrog sku: sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba zang yag gtsigs: spyan gsum dmar zlum sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs: dbu skra dmar ser srid pa'i rtse mor 'bar: phyag g.yas dbang sdud rdo rje nam mkhar phyar: g.yon pas zil gnon lcag sdigs mgo dgu bsnams: sku la zab ber ljang smug ser bkra gsol: zhabs gnyis 'dor thabs mu stegs dam sri mnan: gzi brjid mdangs ldan me dpung klong du bzhugs: bdud 'dul dpa' bo'i sku ru bskyed: oṃ badz+ra gu ru siṃ haḥghaṇ+ḍe dharma dhā tu hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: gsang sngags snying po 'brug ltar sgrog pa yi: mdun du gru gsum mthing nag me rlung 'khrugs pa'i dbus: khrag zhag rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i klong dkyil du: gnam lcags las grub 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dbus: pad+ma nyi ma 'bar ba'i gdan steng du: dgra bgegs pho mo gcal du bkram pa'i steng: rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las: hūm̐ yig tsha zer skar mda' lta bur 'phros: hūm̐ nyid yongs su gyur pa las: 'od zer dpag yas nam mkha' gang bar 'phros: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad nas: phyogs dus las mgon ma lus thams cad kyi:

mthu dang nus stobs rdzu 'phrul ma lus pa: 'od zer tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las: che btsan 'gran zla mtha' med gar gyi dbang: bdud mgon chen po seng ge'i gdong pa can: sku mdog mthing nag spyan gsum dmar zlum 'khrugs: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs ljags dmar glog ltar 'khyug: sku la 'jol ber dmar nag lhubs chen gsol: g.yu ral gseb nas seng chung skar ltar 'khrugs: phyag g.yas dar nag ru mtshon dgra la phyar: g.yon pas lcang lor bcas pa'i bhan+dha'i nang: dmar gyi gtor ma gnam lcags thog ltar 'phen: stag ral gzig shubs glog ltar 'khyug: shin tu mi bsrun pa yi cha byad can: chibs su bdud rta nag po rlung gshog bcibs: skad cig nyid la gling bzhi ma lus bskor: dam nyams dgra bo bsgral ba'i las la brtson: srid pa pho rgyud thams cad dbang sdud bsam: de yi g.yon du pad nyi dgra bgegs steng: tri yig dmar nag yongs su gyur pa las: dpal ldan bdud mo seng ge'i gdong pa can: sku mdog dmar nag khro gtum gzi brjid 'bar: dmar zlum 'jigs pa'i spyan gsum khrag ltar khol: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dkar mche ba gtsigs: khrag ral gseb nas seng chung skar ltar 'khrugs: phyag g.yas dgra s+t+wa rtse gsum dar dmar phyar: dgra bgegs gzugs phung tshal pa dum bur 'phen: phyag g.yon bhan+dha lcang lor bcas pa'i nang: dgra snying dmar po khrum khrum zhal du gsol: sku la 'jol ber dmar po lhubs chen gsol: btsan rta dmar po bcibs nas phyogs bcur rgyug: skad cig nyid la dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral: srid pa mo rgyud thams cad dbang sdud bsam: yab yum gnyis kyi mdun nyid du: dhī tri gnyis las bskyed pa yi: las mkhan bam ro pho mo ni: skra med mdog dmar spre 'u'i gdong: lag gnyis bya sder sa la btsugs: rkang pas gtor khyer dgra la 'phen: skad cig nyid la stong gsum bskor: dam nyams dgra bgegs ma lus rtsad nas gcod:

phyogs mtshams 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dbus: dgra bgegs jing dur bsnol ba'i steng: shar du tri las skyes bu rdo rje legs pa ni: sku mdog dmar smug sku la ber dkar gsol: dbu la sag zhu smug po mnabs: phyag g.yas rdo rje nam mkhar phyar: g.yon pas dgra snying zhal du gsol: chibs su seng ge dkar mo 'chib: lho phyogs ya las gshin rje gshed po ni: sku mdog ljang nag mun pa'i 'jol ber gsol: phyag g.yas be con nam mkhar phyar: g.yon pas rgyu zhags dgra la 'phen: chibs su chu glang sngon po 'chib: nub tu phu las klu bdud mgo dgu ni: sku mdog sngo nag gcer bu sbrul mjug 'khyil: phyag g.yas sbrul zhags nam mkhar phyar: g.yon pas dug gi par bu bsnams: chibs su chu srin dmar po 'chib: byang du du las bdud rje rkang ring ni: sku mdog nag po 'jigs pa'i ber nag gsol: phyag g.yas ral gri nam mkhar phyar: g.yon pas bdud zhags nag po bsnams: chibs su rta nag rting dkar 'chib: shar lhaur tsa las btsan 'gong yam shud ni: sku mdog dmar nag 'jigs pa'i ber dmar gsol: phyag g.yas btsan mdung dmar po phyar: g.yon pas btsan zhags dgra la 'debs: chibs su btsan rta dmar po 'chib: lho nub ra las yab rje tshangs pa ni: sku mdog dmar smug sku la ber dkar gsol: phyag g.yas spu gri nam mkhar phyar: g.yon pas dar dkar ru mtshon bsnams: chibs su cang shes dkar po 'chib: nub byang tri las srin po na ra siṃ ha ni: sku mdog dud kha 'jol ber ljang gu gsol: phyag g.yas khram shing nam mkhar phyar: g.yon pas lcags kyu dgra la 'debs: chibs su bong bu kham nag 'chib: byang shar ma las rdo rje ba lam ma: sku mdog nag po 'jigs pa'i ber smug gsol: phyag g.yas ral gri nam mkhar phyar: g.yon pas nad rkyal dgra la lhod: chibs su dril nag gwa pa 'chib: de ltar shan pa gtum po rnams: rang rang 'khor tshogs bsam mi khyab: kun kyang rngam brjid khros pa'i gzugs:

cho rol gcig tu ma nges pa: rnam sprul bye ba dpag med 'gyed: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las la brtson: gzhan yang ma tshogs mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang: bka' nyan las byed bsam mi khyab: seng ge gtum po glang chen smyon pa dang: stag gzig dom dred ce spyang sna tshogs dang: dur bya kang ka khra dang 'ug pa dang: gzhan yang dam nyams dgra bo'i rjes gcod pa: phag rgod mi rgod bud med nag mo dang: bya nag gshog sgra khyi nag khangs se khang: g.yag rog rwa bdar so sgra khrugs se khrug: mi nag 'bum gyis 'o dod lhang lhang 'bod: la la thog dang ser ba'i bdag: la las ri rab pang la 'debs: la las rgya mtsho hub kyis 'thung: la las nyi zla cha lang rdeb: la las rang sha rang gis za: la las nang rol spar mos 'debs: la las rang lus dum bur gtub: la las dgra bgegs mgo lus phral: la las mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bskor: la las ha ha hūm̐ phaṭa sgrog: kun kyang dgra bgegs bsgral la brtson: gzhan yang dur khrod rab 'jigs der: dug gi sdong po dug gi chu mig dang: bskal pa'i me rlung rab tu 'khrugs: sprul pa'i 'khor tshogs mang pos bskor: lha tshogs de dag thams cad kyi: spyi bor oṃ dang mgrin par ā: thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas: dur khrod brgyad dang he ru ka'i gnas bcu dang: 'jig rten dang ni 'jig rten 'das pa yi: rgyal ba'i zhing khams rnam par dag pa nas: bdud mgon seng gdong yab yum 'khor bcas rnams: mchod cing sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no: mdun bskyed kyi le'u ste gnyis pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: sha chen la sogs spos sna tshogs bsreg: pho gling mo gling la sogs pa'i rol mo sna tshogs bsgrags la 'di skad do: hūm̐ bh+yo: dur khrod chen po mkha' spyod tsa ri nas: che mchog kun gyi 'phrin las gcig bsdus pa: zhing skyong kun dga' gzhon nu yab yum dang: bka' nyan las byed dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs:

sngon gyi dam bcas gnyan po ma g.yel bar: ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: hūm̐ bh+yo: sngon tshe pad+ma dbang dang pad 'byung spyan snga ru: seng gdong khyod kyis ji ltar khas blangs bzhin: 'phrin las drag po'i las la spyan 'dren no: gsang sngags bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba'i phyir: ma thogs gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐ bh+yo: sde brgyad yongs kyi dmag dpon mdzad tsam na: dur khrod bsil ba tshal nas gshegs su gsol: seng gdong sprul pa grangs med 'gyed tsam na: gangs dkar ti se'i gnas nas gshegs= sgrub brgyud bstan pa phyogs bcur spel tsam na: 'brog chen la phyi'i gnas nas gshegs= ma mo mkha' 'gro'i gtso bo mdzad tsam na: rnam dag o rgyan gnas nas gshegs= zab gter bka' yi srung ma mdzad tsam na: ban ri pad+ma 'od nas gshegs= gsang sngags bstan pa phyogs bcur spel tsam na: rnam dag mkha' spyod gnas nas gshegs= rnal 'byor dgra bla chen po mdzad tsam na: dhe wī ko ṭi'i gnas nas gshegs= bstan pa'i ru tra ma lus bsgral tsam na: mthu stobs drag po'i klong nas gshegs su gsol: hūm̐ bh+yo: bdud mgon seng gdong yab yum dang: dregs pa sde brgyad dmag tshogs rnams: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol: gsang sngags bstan pa spel phyir gshegs= rnal 'byor dgra bla mdzad phyir gshegs= log 'dren byad ma 'dul phyir gshegs= sa bdag klu gnyan 'dul phyir gshegs= rgyal 'gong dam sri 'dul phyir gshegs= dgra bgegs jing dur 'dul phyir gshegs= mi nad phyugs nad bzlog phyir gshegs= nad mug mtshon 'khrugs bzlog phyir gshegs= mi mthun rkyen ngan bzlog phyir gshegs su gsol: spyan 'dren pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: dur khrod rab 'jigs 'bar ba'i gzhal yas su: gru gsum mthing nag e yi klong dkyil du:

zhing bcu dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i gdan steng du: bdud mgon seng gdong yab yum 'khor dang bcas: dgyes shing mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: bzhugs su gsol ba'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: chos sku skye med kun bzang he ru ka: longs sku 'gag med dpal chen seng ge'i sgra: sprul sku bdud mgon seng ge'i gdong pa can: mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul nus pa'i shugs 'chang ba: bdud mgon seng gdong yab yum 'khor bcas la: gnyis med gus pa'i tshul gyis phyag 'tshal lo: na mo pu ru sha ya ho: phyag 'tshal ba'i le'u ste lnga pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: zhing skyong kun dga' gzhon nu yab yum 'khor bcas la: dam rdzas dgyes mchod sna tshogs 'bul ba ni: sha khrag la sogs ba liṃ mchod pa 'bul: thugs dam dbang gis dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol: dbang po lnga sogs keṃ rus mchod pa 'bul: rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis bar chad thams cad zlog: klad khrag la sogs bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: sprul pa'i stobs kyis mi mthun 'gal rkyen zlog: snying khrag la sogs nang khrol gsang mchod 'bul: bzhad pa'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs: gha ṇa la sogs longs spyod mchod pa 'bul: 'dod pa'i dngos grub ma lus bdag la stsol: mi mthun rkyen ngan bar chad zlog tu gsol: 'dir brgyud pa'i bla ma'i mtshan don sbyar zhing: sngags kyi khā hi btags shing 'bul: mchod 'bul gyi le'u ste drug pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: dur khrod bdag po zhing skyong seng ge'i gdong: de yi yum chen srin mo seng gdong ma: bkra shis dpal 'bar nor gyi dngos grub gter: stobs chen yid 'gugs lha mo dbyings phyug ma: dngos grub bdag mo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: bkra shis tshan che mthu che rno la myur:

zlog pas mi bzlog sngags zlog dgra bo'i gshed: rbod gtong phar bzlog nus pa rang gshed 'beb: bdud mgon seng gdong sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dregs pa 'dul zhing dgra bgegs kun gyi gshed: ltas ngan cho 'phrul rgyug pa'i zhor la 'beb: dam nyams tshe srog glo bur sdud mdzad pa: drag po sgrol byed gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: nang du zhi zhing bkra shis bu nor spel: phyi ru khros pas rtsub 'gyur 'jig rten g.yo: ba dan phyar bas sangs rgyas bstan pa srung: g.yu ral bsigs pas seng chung skar ltar 'khrugs: zhing skyong dpal 'bar thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: spyan dmar glog 'khyug srid gsum 'od kyis gang: ljags dmar brdab pas sa gzhi g.yo zhing 'khrugs: dmar gtor gdengs pas nad yams char bzhin 'beb: bdud rta brgyugs pas lha srin brgyal zhing 'bog: dmag dpon seng gdong dgra 'dul sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ bh+yo: bstan pa srung zhing bka' yi bya ra mdzad: rnal 'byor mgo 'don sngags 'chang tshe srog sring: nang du zhi bas yid bzhin lha mo 'dra: phyi ru khros pas phra men ser ltar 'khrugs: dam nyams drug khri nyin bzhin gsod par byed: gung gnyis rgyug pas dkor rkun rtsad nas gcod: rno myur seng gdong sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: zlog pas mi bzlog gzhan gyis mi chun zhing: bka' srung bdud tshogs dgra la rang gshed 'beb: bdag la byams shing nang du dngos grub ster: bkra shis snying nye grogs ltar rtag tu srung: gsung sgros gcig thos las ni tshar gsum sgrub: bu ltar 'tsho zhing cho ltar skyong ba'i lha: ḍā ki seng gdong gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: gsang sngags bka' srung rnal 'byor dgra bla che: bdud kyi g.yul 'joms ma rungs dgra bgegs sgrol: rdzu 'phrul mthu yis lha srin dbang sdud cing: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i las la brtson: srin mo'i gzugs kyis dgra la nad yams 'beb:

dpal 'bar seng gdong thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ bh+yo: yab yum gnyis kyi bka' nyan mthu rtsal can: bam ro pho mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ bh+yo: bka' yi las byed shan pa sde brgyad tshogs: dregs pa lcam dral rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: dam nyams dgra la ltas ngan sna tshogs thongs: skyes bu chen po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dam nyams dgra bgegs ma lus khram la thobs: gshin rje chos rgyal sku la phyag= dam nyams dgra la mdze nad char bzhin phob: klu bdud mgo dgu'i sku la phyag= dam nyams dgra bgegs ma lus zhags pas chings: bdud rje nag po'i sku la phyag= dam nyams dgra la ye 'drog sna tshogs thongs: btsan 'gong dmar po'i sku la phyag= dam nyams dgra la 'ja' 'khyil ltas ngan thongs: lha bdud dkar po'i sku la phyag= dam nyams dgra bgegs dmod pa'i mtshon chas phungs: srin po dhar dha'i sku la phyag= dam nyams dgra la khrag nad char bzhin phob: rdo rje ba lam sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ bh+yo: gzhan yang las mkhan dregs pa'i dmag tshogs rnams: gtso bo'i bka' bzhin rang gis las byed pa: bstan pa'i dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du brlag: bka' nyan las byed tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: bstod pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: de nas tshogs mchod bya ba ni/

hūm̐: rang byung lhun grub bhan+dha'i snod nang du: ro brgya ldan pa'i tshogs mchod dam pa 'di: dpa' bo 'bru lnga'i 'phro 'du las byung ba'i: glo bur rnam rtog nyes skyon kun bral zhing: ye shes bdud rtsi chen por byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ha ho hrī: de nas tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gu ru pad 'byung rtsa gsum lha yi lha: sgrub pa bka' brgyad zhi khro rab 'byams dang: gnas gsum mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: dur khrod khrag mtsho me 'bar gzhal yas nas: zhing skyong chen po seng gdong yab yum dang: dug mtshon ming sring dregs pa sde brgyad dang: bka' nyan las byed shan pa gri thogs bcas: sprul pa yang sprul pho nya mngags gzhug rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la brtan par bzhugs: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: de nas tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i tshogs mchod dam rdzas 'di: pad 'byung rtsa gsum lha tshogs bcas la 'bul: sprul pa'i khro rgyal seng gdong rje la 'bul: yum chen ḍā ki seng gdong ma la 'bul: las mkhan bam ro pho mo'i tshogs la 'bul: dam can skyes bu 'chi bdag gshin rje dang: klu bdud mgo dgu bdud rje rkang ring dang: btsan 'gong dmar po srog bdag tshangs pa dang: lha bdud srin po ma mo ba lam sogs: dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs la mchod pa 'bul: 'jig rten dang ni ye shes las grub pa'i: phyi nang bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: rgyal chen sde bzhi nor lha rgya mtshor bcas: sprul pa yang sprul pho nya las mkhan tshogs: pho rgyud mo rgyud bka' yi bya ra sogs: gnas srung gter bdag rnams la tshogs mchod 'bul: rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol: sngags 'chang tshe srog bsring phyir bzhes su gsol:

yang zab bstan pa spel phyir bzhes su gsol: rigs rgyud chos brgyud spel phyir bzhes su gsol: dbang sdud lha mi 'dul phyir bzhes su gsol: tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas phyir bzhes su gsol: snyan grags phyogs bcur spel phyir bzhes su gsol: gnod byed dgra bgegs bsgral phyir bzhes su gsol: log 'dren bdud rigs 'dul phyir bzhes su gsol: dgra bgegs mtha' dmag bzlog phyir bzhes su gsol: sarba ga ṇa tsakra pū tsa la khā hi: tshogs mchod kyi le'u ste dgu pa'o: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: de nas lhag ma stob pa ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: lhag la dbang ba gtor chen tshogs: dregs pa pho mo dam can lhag sdud rnams: bka' yi pha 'bab lhag gtor 'di bzhes la: dgra bgegs mtha' yi dmag dpung rdul du rlogs: lhag gtor gyi le'u ste bcu pa'o: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: de nas chad mdo bya ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la: 'og min chos dbyings bde chen pho brang du: bcom ldan dpal chen pad+ma dbang chen gyis: snang srid ma mo dam la btags pa'i tshe: chos kyi dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro thams cad kyis: rang rang gzugs bstan srog snying phul ba'i tshe: bstan pa gnyan bsrung bka' yi gtor len chad: sngon gyi dam tshig ma g.yel ci bcol las kun sgrubs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dgra bgegs mtha' yi dmag dpung rdul du rlogs: hūm̐ bh+yo: de 'og bar gyi bskal pa'i dbu ma la: gnod sbyin rdzong gi dur khrod chen po ru: slob dpon pad+ma rig 'dzin hūm̐ kā ras: gsang ba snying thig dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: las mkhan dug mtshon pho mo ming sring gis: rang rang rtsal shugs che bar bstan pa'i dus: 'phags pa seng ge sgra sgrog skur bzhengs tshe: dregs pa ming sring srog snying mngon du phul: bstan pa gnyan bsrung bka' yi gtor len chad: sngon gyi dam tshig ma g.yel ci bcol las kun sgrubs:

sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dgra bgegs mtha' yi dmag dpung rdul du rlogs: hūm̐ bh+yo: dus bskal 'das pa de yi 'og rol du: byang phyogs bod yul kha ba'i ri ljongs 'dir: stag tshang seng ge'i bsam 'grub ke'u tshang du: rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma bdud 'dul gyis: ye shes mtsho rgyal khye'u chung lo tsā la: yang gsang snying thig dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dregs pa sde brgyad rol pa rkya bdun gyis: rang rang srog snying mngon du phul ba'i tshe: bstan pa gnyan bsrung bka' yi gtor len chad: sngon gyi tha tshig ma g.yel ci bcol las kun sgrubs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dgra bgegs mtha' yi dmag dpung rdul du rlogs: hūm̐ bh+yo: da dus rtsod ldan bskal pa'i yang mtha' 'dir: lho nub pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas su: rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma thod phreng gis: snyigs ma'i gdung 'tshob bdud 'dul rdo rje la: gsang ba snying thig bskyed rdzogs byin pa'i tshe: bdud mgon lcam dral bka' sdod 'khor bcas dang: phyi nang bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho yis: rang rang gzugs bstan srog snying phul ba'i tshe: yang gsang bstan pa phyogs bcur spel ba dang: log gshed bdud rigs ma lus bsgral bar chad: sngon gyi tha tshig ma g.yel ci bcol las kun sgrubs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dgra bgegs mtha' yi dmag dpung rdul du rlogs: tha tshig chad mdo'i le'u ste bcu pa'o: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: de nas brtan ma skyong ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la: snang srid dbang sdud pad+ma bdud 'dul nyid: bod yul kha ba'i ljongs 'dir byon pa'i tshe: rgya bod gnyis kyi sa mtshams su: a su ra yi brag phug tu: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang: mthu chen rlangs chen dpal seng gis: dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ bshams nas ni: brtan ma bcu gnyis bran dang g.yog: zhing chen bkram pa'i gdan la bzhag:

dbang bskur gsang ba'i mtshan yang btags: dam tshig rdo rje spyi bor bzhag: lce la ye shes bdud rtsi blud: thar pa thob pa'i lung yang bstan: sngon gyi dam tshig gnyan po rjes dgongs la: da rung khyed rnams 'jig rten ma 'das pas: tha tshig dus la ma g.yel 'phrin las mdzod: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bod khams skye 'gro chos la 'god pa dang: yang gsang bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas byed cing: mthong thos dran reg sangs rgyas sa la sbyor: khyad par gsang sngags bstan par 'tshe byed cing: skye 'gro yongs la gnod par byed pa yi: zhing bcu'i mtha' dmag thal ba rdul du rlogs: brtan ma skyong ba'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: de nas shis pa brjod pa ni: hrī: sgrub mchog rnal 'byor mched lcam la: thugs rje'i klong nas byin rlabs char rgyun 'beb: rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog: dngos grub rnam gnyis char ltar 'beb mdzad pa: yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bkra shis shog: 'phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med sgrub mdzad pa: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bkra shis shog: bstan pa bsrung zhing rnal 'byor grogs mdzad pa: zhing skyong kun dga' gzhon nu'i bkra shis shog: bar chad sel zhing longs spyod char bzhin 'beb: yum chen seng ge'i gdong can bkra shis shog: phyi nang bdud rigs bar chad sel mdzad pa: bka' nyan dug mtshon pho mo'i bkra shis shog: gnod byed dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol mdzad pa: dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs kyi bkra shis shog: dgra bgegs mtha' dmag rdul du brlag mdzad pa: las mkhan pho nya rnams kyi bkra shis shog: rjes spyod kyi rim pa brjod pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas: legs spyad 'di la nyes pa gang: 'dir ni bgyi ba gang bgyis pa: zhing skyong yab yum bka' nyan ming sring dang:

'khor gyi dregs pa sde brgyad la sogs pa: bka' sdod las mkhan tshogs la bzod par gsol: yi ge brgya pa brjod: rten yod na 'di ltar brjod: sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchog 'di rnams la: ji srid 'byung bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig bar: de srid 'dir ni brtan par bzhugs su gsol: ji srid bar du brtan par bzhugs nas kyang: sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: mgon skyabs dpung gnyen sdongs grogs mdzad du gsol: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha: sogs/ de nas sngags kyi sham bur dbyangs gsal dang rten 'brel snying po brjod par bya'o: sku rten med na gshegs su gsol ba ni: oṃ: khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad: rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol: rang rang yul du gshegs nas kyang: slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol: badz+ra mu: yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang: de nas bsngo ba bya ba ni: hūm̐: bdud mgon seng gdong yab yum lha tshogs bsgrubs lags kyis: legs byas de yi dge ba ci mchis pa: pha ma 'gro drug sems can don du bsngo: myur du rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog: bka' btsan byin chags 'di bsgrubs byin rlabs kyis: rdo rje slob dpon shes rab gzung mar bcas: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin mched lcam thams cad kyi: byang chub sgrub pa'i nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing: tshe 'di nyid la rig 'dzin mchog 'grub shog: gang du sgrub pa'i yul der bkra shis shing: sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig: bstan la gnod cing skye 'gror 'tshe byed pa: zhing bcu'i sde rnams myur du brlag gyur cig: sa phyogs yul ris rgyal khams thams cad du: char chu dus 'beb lo phyugs rtag legs shing: mi nad phyugs nad dal yams rgyun chad nas: mtshon 'khrugs mu ge byad dug kun zhi zhing: 'gro drug sems can bde skyid 'byung gyur cig: zhing skyong gzi ldan bsgrubs mchod byin rlabs kyis:

dgra bgegs bdud dpung ma lus myur bsgral nas: bstan dgra mtha' dmag myur du brlag gyur cig: rjes chog bsngo ba'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: de nas rdzogs rim ni: phyi nang 'khor 'das snang srid kun: dpal chen 'phags pa'i sku la thim: de yang 'od phung 'ja' ltar yal: brjod bral dbyings rig ma bu 'dres: gdod ma'i kun bzang dgongs pa 'o: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: e ma chos skyong kun gyi srog thig gcig bsdus pa: rgyal ba'i bstan srung kun gyi stobs 'dus pa: shin tu gces pa'i yang snying 'di: pad+ma bdud 'dul bka' bzhin du: mkhar chen mtsho rgyal bdag 'dras yi ger bkod: ma 'ongs rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i yang mtha'i dus: gnam lcags me 'bar bdud 'dul rdo rje rtsal zhes grags: pad+ma'i sras mchog de dang 'phrad par shog: 'phrad nas bdud rigs ma lus thams cad kyi: srog snying dmar po myur du lon pa dang: mtha' yi dmag dpung myur du bzlog par shog: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: 1$0000230kye ma gu ru pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i gsung 'dzin rig pa 'dzin// dus mtha'i gter ston ma nyes kha yog mi kha sdang*// mi rigs gzhan las khas nyen dbang chung yang*// rang sems zol med g.yo med e ma hoḥ /rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rje ngas/ tsha ba sgro brag ces tsit+ta gnam langs 'dra ba'i mgul nas bton/ yig rigs mi 'dra dgu 'dug ste: ma dag pa gcig kyang med/ shog ser ngos nas dag par phab pa'o// bdud mgon khyod la mthu rtsal ci mchis ang*// dam nyams bdud rigs ma lus thams cad kyi// snying khrag dmar po myur du thang la phos// sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
